intent: Illustrate review of input rejection and revision advancement in the lifecycle example.

decisions.text: Consider malformed task and command input before lifecycle rules.
decisions.rationale: A reviewer needs to see the input boundary as well as the state model.

decisions.text: Consider exactly one revision increment on each accepted command.
decisions.rationale: Revision advancement is part of the example's intended behavior.

questions.text: Which independently executed cases establish the input-boundary behavior for this exact model and adapter?
Which case should be explicitly linked to revision advancement?
